a.text: The answer: A thread is a second program counter and a second

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: stack inside the same address space; code, heap and globals are

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: shared, and the page table stays the same at a switch. Two

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: threads on 2 cores summed the array in about half the time. The

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: cost: nobody controls which thread runs first.

a.title: The answer

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: The answer: One line of C is load, add, store, with the value in

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: a private register in between. A second thread's load landing in

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: that gap (after a switch, or on the other core) loses an add.

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: Each thread made 10,000,000 adds; the total came out short, by a

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: different amount every run. The lines that touch shared data are

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.title: The answer

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: The answer: pthread_create starts a function as a thread with one

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: argument; pthread_join waits and collects the result; a mutex

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: around the critical section made 20,000,000 every run. The cost:

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: 23 times slower in the first pair of runs (31 in the second), and

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: the inside of lock() is still a mystery.

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
